name: Meteora DAMM V2
rootCause: Meteora suffered a $1.5 million USDC loss in a fake OTC escrow scam while attempting to buy back its $MET token. Scammers deceived the team using a fraudulent escrow setup for an OTC deal. This was not a smart contract exploit but a social engineering attack. The incident was disclosed in Meteora’s Q1 2026 Token Holder Report, where they also mentioned filing a police report. The protocol used $1M USDC for legitimate buybacks separately.

descriptions.text: Meteora suffered a $1.5 million USDC loss in a fake OTC escrow scam while attempting to buy back its $MET token. Scammers deceived the team using a fraudulent escrow setup for an OTC deal. This was not a smart contract exploit but a social engineering attack. The incident was disclosed in Meteora’s Q1 2026 Token Holder Report, where they also mentioned filing a police report. The protocol used $1M USDC for legitimate buybacks separately.

Meteora DAMM V2 lost about $1.5 million on Solana after an OTC MET buyback payment was redirected to a fraudulent counterparty during a social-engineering scam. The buyback process relied on off-chain identity and escrow verification for an OTC settlement, which allowed a fraudulent counterparty to receive the payment. No DAMM v2 contract defect has been established.
